title: Bookmark list filtering rejects prayer bookmark types that delete supports
reasoning: The delete endpoint explicitly treats `prayer` and `prayerset` as valid bookmark content types in the `prayers` app, but the list endpoint's `content_type` filter only special-cases hub models and otherwise looks in the `learning_resources` app. A user with prayer bookmarks can delete `/bookmarks/prayer/<id>/`, but `GET /bookmarks/?content_type=prayer` will resolve the wrong app label, catch `ContentType.DoesNotExist`, and return an empty result set. That makes the bookmark filtering API inconsistent for a content type the same module otherwise supports.
recommendation: Share the content-type resolution logic between bookmark list/delete/create paths, or add the missing `prayer` and `prayerset` mapping to `BookmarkListView.get_queryset`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for bookmark content-type filtering, and the inconsistency is visible only by comparing the two endpoints in this file.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a prayer bookmark for an authenticated user, then assert `GET /api/learning-resources/bookmarks/?content_type=prayer` returns it instead of an empty page.
minimumFixScope: Update bookmark content-type resolution in `BookmarkListView.get_queryset` and cover the supported cross-app bookmark types.
